cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.discount_idr) AS total_discount_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)

cases.sql: SELECT s.courier, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST((CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) - CAST((s.shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)) AS DECIMAL)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS avg_delivery_days FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS s WHERE s.shipment_status = 'delivered' AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.courier ORDER BY s.courier

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS whatsapp_tickets FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE t.contact_channel = 'whatsapp' AND CAST((t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE)
cases.answer: There were 1,231 support tickets opened through WhatsApp in 2026, using WIB dates. Available activity ends on September, so October through December are not included.

cases.sql: SELECT c.channel_name AS channel, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_name
assumptions: Tahun 2025 ditafsirkan sebagai tahun kalender berdasarkan tanggal bisnis WIB.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “During 2025” means the full calendar year, summed across all stores and days.
cases.answer: The total number of store visitors recorded across all stores and days during the full calendar year was 291,021.

cases.sql: WITH order_subcategory AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.category_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.level = 2 GROUP BY o.order_id, c.category_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, c.category_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.level = 2 GROUP BY r.order_id, c.category_id) SELECT c.category_name AS subcategory, SUM(os.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_subcategory AS os JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = os.category_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = os.order_id AND r.category_id = os.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: “2025” means calendar year 2025, using WIB order dates.
Subcategories are level-2 product categories; refunds are attributed to the subcategory of the returned order line and the order's date.
cases.answer: The three highest-net-revenue subcategories were Smartphones (IDR 20.1B), Audio (IDR 14.8B), and Computers & Accessories (IDR 11.1B). The query uses calendar-year order dates in WIB and attributes refunds to the returned item’s subcategory and the order date.

cases.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_cost_idr) AS purchase_order_value_idr FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.ordered_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.ordered_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.po_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY purchase_order_value_idr DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: “Tahun 2025” ditafsirkan sebagai tahun kalender 2025 berdasarkan ordered_date.
Nilai PO dihitung sebagai quantity × unit_cost_idr, lalu dijumlahkan per pemasok; PO berstatus cancelled dikecualikan.
cases.answer: Lima pemasok dengan nilai purchase order terbesar pada tahun 2025 adalah PD Fujiati Hidayat (Persero) Tbk (01) (Rp 5,75 miliar), UD Hutapea Tbk (03) (Rp 3,22 miliar), CV Dongoran Salahudin (02) (Rp 2,79 miliar), PT Rahimah (Persero) Tbk (04) (Rp 1,52 miliar), dan Perum Zulkarnain (14) (Rp 1,27 miliar). Perhitungan menggunakan tahun kalender berdasarkan tanggal pemesanan, menjumlahkan kuantitas dikalikan biaya satuan, dan mengecualikan PO yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_format, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_format ORDER BY s.store_format
assumptions: “2025” means calendar year 2025 in WIB.
Count orders that were not cancelled, including refunded orders.
cases.answer: In calendar 2025 (WIB), excluding cancelled orders and including refunded ones, flagship stores had 1,648 orders, mall stores had 13,733, and street stores had 6,019.

cases.sql: SELECT r.city AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS online_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = cu.region_id WHERE ch.is_online = TRUE AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.city ORDER BY online_orders DESC, city LIMIT 1
assumptions: City means the registered customer's home city, not the fulfilling store's city.
cases.answer: Using registered customer home city and counting cancelled online orders, Jakarta had the most online orders in 2026, with 2,139. The available order data runs through September.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, COUNT(*) AS stockout_product_days FROM analytics.fact_inventory_daily AS i JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = i.store_id WHERE i.snapshot_date >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND i.snapshot_date < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.on_hand_qty = 0 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY stockout_product_days DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Paling sering kehabisan stok” diukur sebagai jumlah pengamatan produk-toko-hari dengan stok akhir hari 0 selama September 2026.
cases.answer: Toko yang paling sering kehabisan stok selama September 2026 adalah Arunika Bekasi Cikarang, dengan 88 pengamatan produk-toko-hari yang stok akhirnya nol.

cases.sql: SELECT e.employee_code AS employee_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_in_store_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.dim_employee AS e ON e.employee_id = o.sales_employee_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND ch.channel_code = 'store' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY e.employee_code ORDER BY completed_in_store_orders DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “In-store” means the store channel (channel_code = 'store').
cases.answer: Using the calendar-year and store-channel definitions, EMP-00233 served the most completed in-store orders, with 152 orders.

cases.sql: SELECT r.region_group AS region_group, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_customer AS c JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY r.region_group
cases.answer: Registered customers by region group: Bali has 975, Jabodetabek has 9,663, Jawa Barat has 1,950, and Jawa Tengah & DIY has 2,478. Jawa Timur has 2,612, Sulawesi has 1,146, and Sumatera has 1,176.

cases.sql: SELECT p.promo_name AS promotion_name, COUNT(r.redemption_id) AS redemptions FROM analytics.fact_promotion_redemptions AS r JOIN analytics.dim_promotion AS p ON p.promotion_id = r.promotion_id GROUP BY p.promotion_id, p.promo_name ORDER BY redemptions DESC, promotion_name ASC LIMIT 1

cases.answer: The most-redeemed promotion was Ramadan Sale 2026, with 1,301 redemptions. This counts each recorded redemption once across all available data.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-03-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-04-06' AS DATE)
assumptions: Count all orders placed in the specified WIB date range, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: There were 281 orders placed during the Lebaran week, counting all orders in the specified WIB date range, including cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = CAST('2024-12-12' AS DATE)
assumptions: Jumlah pesanan mencakup semua status pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan pada tanggal 12 Desember 2024 adalah 91. Jumlah ini mencakup semua status pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS august_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) AS september_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS order_delta FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o
assumptions: Count all orders, including cancelled orders; the change is September's count minus August's count.
cases.answer: September had 2,110 orders versus 2,114 in August, a change of -4 orders (September minus August); counts include cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS TIME) < CAST('06:00:00' AS TIME)
assumptions: Count all orders regardless of status.
Interpret “between midnight and 6 a.m.” as 00:00 inclusive up to, but not including, 06:00 WIB.
cases.answer: There were 864 orders in 2025 placed between midnight and 6 a.m. Jakarta time. The count includes orders of all statuses and treats midnight as inclusive and 6 a.m. as exclusive.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = t.traffic_date WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND d.is_weekend = TRUE
assumptions: Akhir pekan berarti Sabtu dan Minggu, sesuai penanda is_weekend pada kalender.
cases.answer: Total pengunjung toko pada akhir pekan di bulan Juli 2026 adalah 7.486. Akhir pekan dihitung sebagai Sabtu dan Minggu sesuai penanda kalender.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS business_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) FILTER(WHERE n.business_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND n.business_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE)) AS calendar_q1_2026_net_revenue_idr, SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) FILTER(WHERE n.business_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND n.business_date < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)) AS fiscal_q1_fy2026_net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
cases.answer: Net revenue was IDR 17.8B in calendar Q1 2026 and IDR 19.9B in fiscal Q1 of FY2026. The fiscal period is assumed to run from April through June, while calendar Q1 runs from January through March.

cases.sql: WITH quarters AS (SELECT d.quarter FROM analytics.dim_date AS d WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.quarter), signups AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM c.signup_date) AS INT) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM analytics.dim_customer AS c WHERE c.signup_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.signup_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM c.signup_date) AS INT)) SELECT 'Q' || q.quarter AS calendar_quarter, COALESCE(s.new_customers, 0) AS new_customers FROM quarters AS q LEFT JOIN signups AS s ON s.quarter = q.quarter ORDER BY q.quarter
assumptions: A new customer is counted by signup_date; show all four 2025 calendar quarters, including quarters with no signups.
cases.answer: New customers were counted by signup date: Q1 had 1,263, Q2 had 1,367, Q3 had 1,442, and Q4 had 1,428. All calendar quarters are included, including any with no signups.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date ASC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Receive orders” means orders placed, grouped by their WIB order date; all order statuses are counted.
If multiple dates tie, return the earliest date.
cases.answer: The company received the most orders on 2025-11-11, with 183 orders. This counts all order statuses by WIB order date; ties are resolved in favor of the earliest date.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
cases.answer: Using WIB business dates and the April-to-March fiscal year, total net revenue in FY2025 was IDR 74B.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Tahun kalender 2025 dihitung berdasarkan tanggal bisnis WIB.
Gross sales mengikuti definisi kanonis: nilai baris sebelum diskon dan retur, tidak termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Gross sales selama tahun kalender yang diminta adalah Rp 78,1 miliar, berdasarkan tanggal bisnis WIB dan definisi kanonis yang mengecualikan pesanan yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Uses the canonical AOV definition: average order value after line discounts and before refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: The average order value for app orders in 2026 was IDR 3.4M, using the canonical definition (after line discounts, before refunds, and excluding cancelled orders) and available data through the end of September.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Tahun 2025 berarti tahun kalender berdasarkan tanggal WIB sesi.
Tingkat konversi mengikuti definisi kanonis: sesi app yang dikonversi dibagi seluruh sesi app.
cases.answer: Tingkat konversi sesi di app selama tahun 2025 adalah 8,3%. Perhitungan menggunakan sesi app berdasarkan tanggal WIB dan membagi sesi yang dikonversi dengan seluruh sesi app.

cases.sql: WITH eligible_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), sold AS (SELECT eo.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units FROM eligible_orders AS eo JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id GROUP BY eo.channel_id), returned AS (SELECT eo.channel_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM eligible_orders AS eo JOIN analytics.fact_returns AS r ON r.order_id = eo.order_id GROUP BY eo.channel_id) SELECT c.channel_name AS channel, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(r.returned_units, 0) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.dim_channel AS c LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id LEFT JOIN returned AS r ON r.channel_id = c.channel_id ORDER BY c.channel_name

cases.answer: Toko yang paling sering kehabisan stok selama September 2026 adalah Arunika Bekasi Cikarang, dengan 88 snapshot produk-toko harian yang stok akhirnya nol.

cases.sql: SELECT e.employee_code AS employee_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_in_store_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.dim_employee AS e ON e.employee_id = o.sales_employee_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND ch.channel_code = 'store' AND e.job_role = 'sales_associate' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY e.employee_code ORDER BY completed_in_store_orders DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: In-store orders are identified by channel_code = 'store'; sales associates are employees with job_role = 'sales_associate'.
cases.answer: The sales associate with the most completed in-store orders in 2025 was EMP-00233, with 152 orders. The query treats 2025 as the calendar year in WIB.

cases.sql: SELECT r.region_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_region AS r LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY r.region_group
cases.answer: Registered customers by region group: Bali — 975; Jabodetabek — 9,663; Jawa Barat — 1,950; Jawa Tengah & DIY — 2,478; Jawa Timur — 2,612; Sulawesi — 1,146; and Sumatera — 1,176.

cases.sql: SELECT p.promo_name AS promotion_name, COUNT(r.redemption_id) AS redemptions FROM analytics.fact_promotion_redemptions AS r JOIN analytics.dim_promotion AS p ON p.promotion_id = r.promotion_id GROUP BY p.promotion_id, p.promo_name ORDER BY redemptions DESC, promotion_name LIMIT 1
assumptions: Counted recorded redemptions across the full available data period; cancelled-order promotions are not recorded as redemptions.
cases.answer: The most-redeemed promotion was Ramadan Sale 2026, with 1,301 redemptions. This counts recorded redemptions across the full available data period; promotions on cancelled orders are not recorded as redemptions.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-03-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-04-06' AS DATE)
assumptions: Counts all orders placed in the date range, including orders later cancelled.
cases.answer: There were 281 orders placed during the Lebaran week of 2025, from 31 March to 6 April. This count includes orders that were later cancelled.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = CAST('2024-12-12' AS DATE)
assumptions: Jumlah pesanan mencakup semua status, termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Terdapat 91 pesanan pada tanggal yang ditanyakan; jumlah ini mencakup semua status, termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS orders_aug_2026, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) AS orders_sep_2026 FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) SELECT orders_aug_2026, orders_sep_2026, orders_sep_2026 - orders_aug_2026 AS order_change, ROUND((CAST((orders_sep_2026 - orders_aug_2026) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(orders_aug_2026, 0)) * 100, 4) AS order_change_pct FROM monthly_orders
assumptions: Count all placed orders, including cancelled orders; change is September minus August.
Also report percentage change relative to August.
cases.answer: Counting all placed orders, including cancelled orders, and calculating September minus August, the change was -4 orders (-0.2%%), a decrease.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS TIME) < CAST('06:00:00' AS TIME)
assumptions: “Between midnight and 6 a.m.” means from 00:00 inclusive to 06:00 exclusive, Jakarta time.
Count all orders, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: There were 864 orders placed from midnight inclusive to before 6 a.m. Jakarta time in 2025, including cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = t.traffic_date WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND d.is_weekend = TRUE
assumptions: Menghitung seluruh pengunjung toko pada hari Sabtu dan Minggu di Juli 2026.
cases.answer: Total pengunjung toko pada akhir pekan adalah 7.486, dengan menghitung pengunjung pada hari Sabtu dan Minggu.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), periods AS (SELECT CAST('calendar_q1_2026' AS TEXT) AS period, CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AS end_date UNION ALL SELECT 'fiscal_q1_fy2026', CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE), CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE)) SELECT p.period, COALESCE(SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)), 0) AS net_revenue_idr FROM periods AS p LEFT JOIN order_net AS n ON n.order_date >= p.start_date AND n.order_date < p.end_date LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY p.period ORDER BY p.period
assumptions: Refunds are attributed to the order date, as specified by the net revenue definition.
cases.answer: Net revenue was IDR 17.8B for calendar_q1_2026 and IDR 17.3B for fiscal_q1_fy2026. The query uses the company’s fiscal calendar and attributes refunds to the order date.

cases.sql: WITH quarters AS (SELECT d.quarter, MIN(d.date_key) AS quarter_start, (MAX(d.date_key) + 1) AS quarter_end FROM analytics.dim_date AS d WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.quarter) SELECT q.quarter AS calendar_quarter, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers FROM quarters AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.signup_date >= q.quarter_start AND c.signup_date < q.quarter_end GROUP BY q.quarter ORDER BY q.quarter
assumptions: Calendar quarters follow Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, Jul–Sep, and Oct–Dec.
cases.answer: New customers signed up by calendar quarter in 2025: quarter 1, 1,263; quarter 2, 1,367; quarter 3, 1,442; and quarter 4, 1,428. Calendar quarters follow Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, Jul–Sep, and Oct–Dec.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date ASC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Count all orders placed, including cancelled orders, because the question asks when the company received the most orders.
cases.answer: The date with the most orders in 2025 was 2025-11-11, with 183 orders; this includes cancelled orders.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: Refunds are attributed to the order's WIB date.
cases.answer: Total net revenue for FY2025 was IDR 74B, using the stated fiscal-year definition and attributing refunds to the order’s WIB date.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Tahun kalender 2025 dihitung berdasarkan tanggal bisnis WIB.
cases.answer: Gross sales selama tahun kalender 2025 adalah Rp 78,1 miliar, berdasarkan tanggal bisnis WIB.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ch.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: AOV follows the canonical definition: average order value after line discounts and before refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: The average order value for app orders in 2026 was IDR 3.4M, based on non-cancelled orders after line discounts and before refunds. The query uses WIB order dates and available data through September only.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Tahun 2025 ditafsirkan sebagai tahun kalender WIB.
Konversi dihitung sebagai proporsi sesi aplikasi yang converted, sesuai metrik conversion_rate.
cases.answer: Tingkat konversi sesi di aplikasi selama tahun 2025 adalah 8,3%. Periode ditafsirkan sebagai tahun kalender WIB, dan konversi dihitung sebagai proporsi sesi aplikasi yang berstatus converted.

cases.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.channel_id), returned AS (SELECT o.channel_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_returns AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.channel_id) SELECT ch.channel_name AS channel_name, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(r.returned_units, 0) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(s.sold_units, 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.dim_channel AS ch LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id LEFT JOIN returned AS r ON r.channel_id = ch.channel_id ORDER BY ch.channel_name
assumptions: 2025 means the calendar year, using WIB order dates.
Return rate uses returned units divided by sold units for non-cancelled orders, following the canonical metric. Channels with no sold units have a NULL return rate.
cases.answer: For orders placed in 2025, using WIB order dates and excluding cancelled orders, return rates (returned units divided by sold units) were Marketplace: 4.2%, Mobile app: 5.5%, Physical store: 3.9%, and Website: 5.3%.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: Active customers follow the canonical definition: registered customers with at least one completed order in the 90 days up to and including 30 June 2026.
cases.answer: Using the stated definition—registered customers with at least one completed order in the lookback period—we had 2,911 active customers as of 30 June 2026.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, r.region_group, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, r.region_group), refunds AS (SELECT fr.order_id, SUM(fr.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS fr GROUP BY fr.order_id) SELECT n.region_group, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(f.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS f ON f.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.region_group ORDER BY n.region_group
cases.answer: Pendapatan bersih per region group pada FY2025: Bali Rp 3,47 miliar, Jabodetabek Rp 36,7 miliar, Jawa Barat Rp 6,36 miliar, Jawa Tengah & DIY Rp 10,2 miliar, Jawa Timur Rp 9,95 miliar, Sulawesi Rp 3,54 miliar, dan Sumatera Rp 3,82 miliar. Periode mengikuti asumsi tahun fiskal dari awal April hingga akhir Maret berdasarkan tanggal pesanan WIB.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN order_net AS n ON n.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: September 2026 means the full calendar month in WIB; refunds are attributed to the order date.
cases.answer: The store with the highest net revenue in September 2026 was Arunika Medan Setiabudi, with net revenue of IDR 361M. The query treats September as the full calendar month in WIB and attributes refunds to the order date.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS cancelled_order_percentage FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “In 2025” means the calendar year based on the WIB order date.
The denominator includes all orders placed in 2025, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: Of orders placed in 2025, 3.5%% were cancelled, using WIB calendar dates and all orders placed as the denominator.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), store_revenue AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id WHERE n.order_date >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND n.order_date < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY n.store_id) SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, COALESCE(sr.net_revenue_idr, 0) AS net_revenue_idr, t.target_net_revenue_idr AS target_net_revenue_idr FROM analytics.fact_sales_targets AS t JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = t.store_id LEFT JOIN store_revenue AS sr ON sr.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.month_start = CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND COALESCE(sr.net_revenue_idr, 0) < t.target_net_revenue_idr ORDER BY s.store_name
assumptions: Net revenue uses line value after discounts minus refunds, excluding cancelled orders; refunds are attributed to the order date.
cases.answer: The stores that missed their net revenue targets in August 2026 were Arunika Bandung Antapani, Arunika Bekasi Cikarang, Arunika Bekasi Summarecon, Arunika Bogor Cibinong, Arunika Bogor Pajajaran, Arunika Denpasar Renon, Arunika Denpasar Sanur, Arunika Jakarta Cikini, Arunika Jakarta Kelapa Gading, Arunika Jakarta Kemang, Arunika Jakarta Pondok Indah, Arunika Jakarta Puri Indah, Arunika Jakarta Sunter, Arunika Makassar Losari, Arunika Makassar Panakkukang, Arunika Semarang Banyumanik, Arunika Semarang Simpang Lima, Arunika Surabaya Pakuwon, Arunika Surabaya Rungkut, Arunika Tangerang BSD, and Arunika Tangerang Karawaci. Net revenue is calculated after discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders, with refunds attributed to the order date.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT 2025 AS calendar_year, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: “Last year” means the previous calendar year, 2025.
“Sales” means net revenue: after line discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: Sales last year, measured as net revenue after discounts and refunds and excluding cancelled orders, were IDR 72.8B.

cases.sql: SELECT p.product_name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_order_items AS oi JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Paling laris” berarti produk dengan unit terjual terbanyak sepanjang periode data; pesanan yang dibatalkan dikecualikan, tetapi retur tidak dikurangkan.
cases.answer: Produk paling laris adalah Melati Mascara E85, dengan 5.325 unit terjual. Perhitungan mencakup seluruh periode data, mengecualikan pesanan yang dibatalkan, dan tidak mengurangkan retur.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), channel_sales AS (SELECT CASE WHEN c.is_online THEN 'online' ELSE 'physical_store' END AS sales_channel, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = n.channel_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.is_online THEN 'online' ELSE 'physical_store' END) SELECT sales_channel, net_revenue_idr, orders, ROUND(CAST(net_revenue_idr AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_idr) OVER (), 0), 4) AS revenue_share FROM channel_sales ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC
assumptions: Online combines website, app, and marketplace; stores means the physical-store channel. Sales are net revenue after line discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: Online net revenue was IDR 29.3B across 9,150 orders, slightly ahead of physical stores at IDR 28.6B across 8,800 orders. Online contributed 50.6% of combined net revenue.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT r.region_group, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(f.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS f ON f.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 1
